purpose: Complete performance-information layer for every selectable Genre/Style in the current AI Composition Genre Selection Panel.
governing_rules: Profiles are controlled project baselines, not universal definitions of genres.
Genre selection remains user-only; downstream code may not silently substitute a different genre.
Performance profiles describe musical behavior; instrument physics and manufacturer controls remain in their owning authorities.
Emerging/hybrid/custom categories retain resolver/provenance rules rather than pretending to have one fixed grammar.
No profile may omit a universal required performance field.

ROCK.scope_note: Project-controlled broad Rock baseline; not a universal definition of Rock.
ROCK.groove_behavior: straight or lightly syncopated eighth-note rock pulse; backbeat remains structural but fills and pushes vary by section
ROCK.phrase_behavior: 4- or 8-bar phrases with verse/chorus contrast, fills into boundaries, and selective lead call/response
ROCK.harmony_behavior: tonal major/minor; power-chord, triadic, modal or blues-derived vocabulary; progression must vary across pieces
ROCK.bass_behavior: electric bass locks with kick while retaining independent melodic movement; roots/fifths are a baseline, not a fixed template
ROCK.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: kick/snare backbeat, hi-hat/ride timekeeping, tom/crash transitions; pattern variation required across sections
ROCK.instrument_role_behavior: electric guitar rhythm + lead, electric bass, drum kit; optional acoustic guitar, keys, brass/strings via target resources
ROCK.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm section shares groove hierarchy; lead phrases leave space and answer vocal/melodic gaps
ROCK.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus or sectional builds; density, register and guitar texture change across sections
ROCK.dynamic_behavior: firm but section-shaped; choruses may lift, breakdowns reduce density
ROCK.articulation_behavior: guitar attacks, sustains, mutes, accents and slides follow role; drums use distinct backbeat/fill articulation
ROCK.timing_humanization_behavior: shared groove offsets and phrase pushes; no independent random jitter
ROCK.continuous_performance_control: velocity + expression + note length + target articulation controls
ROCK.sound_effects_intent: amp/drive/reverb/delay are style resources, not mandatory; preserve bass clarity
ROCK.mix_prominence_intent: kick/bass/rhythm foundation clear; lead present selectively rather than constantly
ROCK.production_mastering_intent: punchy transients, controlled low-end, no automatic loudness flattening
ROCK.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: map canonical guitars/bass/drums to target voices; do not replace genre because a patch is missing

New Age.scope_note: Broad New Age baseline; rhythmic/progressive/neo-classical subprofiles may override.
New Age.groove_behavior: low-to-moderate rhythmic aggression; pulse may be flowing, sparse, arpeggiated or absent
New Age.phrase_behavior: longer melodic arcs, breath/release space, gradual entrances and exits
New Age.harmony_behavior: spacious tonal/modal harmony; add9/maj7/sus/open voicings common as options, not requirements
New Age.bass_behavior: structural support with long tones, gentle motion or pedal behavior; avoid rigid repeated two-hit templates
New Age.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: optional light percussion; when present favor supportive texture over dominant backbeat unless subtype says otherwise
New Age.instrument_role_behavior: piano/electric piano/synth, flute, guitar, harp, strings, choir/textures as target resources; role separation foreground vs depth
New Age.ensemble_player_behavior: continuous expressive shaping and low masking between melody and pads/textures
New Age.arrangement_transformation: slow evolution of texture, register, orchestration and space; silence is valid material
New Age.articulation_behavior: legato and sustained articulation favored, with soft attacks where the selected instrument supports them
New Age.timing_humanization_behavior: phrase-level microtiming and tempo breathing; repetition must evolve
New Age.continuous_performance_control: continuous expression, pedal, attack/release and ambience controls when target supports them
New Age.sound_effects_intent: reverb/depth intentional; avoid washing out foreground definition
New Age.mix_prominence_intent: clear foreground/background depth with broad spatial field
New Age.production_mastering_intent: smooth, open, low-harshness master; transient restraint unless subtype requires more activity
New Age.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: prefer expressive target voices; preserve continuous controller curves and long releases
provenance: AllMusic New Age reference already recorded in project

Classical.scope_note: Project common-practice tonal chamber baseline; not all Western classical music.
Classical.groove_behavior: meter hierarchy and phrase rhythm drive motion; no modern groove is imposed unless explicitly hybridized
Classical.phrase_behavior: balanced phrase structures with motivic development, cadence hierarchy and sectional contrast
Classical.harmony_behavior: common-practice tonal baseline with functional harmony and voice-leading; modal/modern classical requires another profile
Classical.bass_behavior: double bass/cello/bassoon or keyboard left hand support harmonic function rather than fixed groove
Classical.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: orchestral percussion optional and structurally motivated rather than constant
Classical.instrument_role_behavior: strings, winds, brass, keyboard and chamber combinations according to role; orchestration must respect instrument authority
Classical.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble follows score-like dynamic/articulation relationships and shared rubato
Classical.arrangement_transformation: motivic development, register transfer, contrapuntal redistribution and formal return
Classical.dynamic_behavior: wide phrase-shaped dynamics including crescendos, diminuendos and terraced contrasts where appropriate
Classical.articulation_behavior: legato/staccato/tenuto/accent/bow/breath intent passed to instrument authority
Classical.timing_humanization_behavior: shared rubato at phrase/cadence level rather than random note displacement
Classical.continuous_performance_control: expression, breath/bow/pedal and tempo curves preserved
Classical.sound_effects_intent: naturalistic room/depth baseline; effects do not replace orchestration
Classical.production_mastering_intent: retain dynamic range; avoid overcompression and excessive brightness
Classical.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: target adapters must honor canonical orchestral identities and articulations

Swing.groove_behavior: swung eighth feel with ride-led pulse and flexible comping; swing ratio varies with tempo/performance
Swing.phrase_behavior: 4/8-bar phrasing with call-response, pickups, turnaround energy and space for improvisatory lines
Swing.harmony_behavior: extended tonal harmony; ii-V motion, secondary dominants, substitutions and blues language available without forcing one progression
Swing.bass_behavior: walking bass structural baseline with chromatic approaches and chord-tone targets
Swing.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: ride pattern + hi-hat/backbeat accents + feathered/supportive kick as target permits; brushes optional
Swing.instrument_role_behavior: piano/guitar comping, acoustic/electric bass, drum kit, sax/brass/clarinet melodic roles
Swing.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm section negotiates shared swing pocket; comping responds to phrases rather than repeating fixed blocks
Swing.arrangement_transformation: head/solo/head or sectional jazz form; density changes under solos and ensemble figures
Swing.dynamic_behavior: interactive accents and phrase crescendos rather than static velocity
Swing.articulation_behavior: legato/tongued horn lines, comping stabs, bass sustain, brush/stick differentiation
Swing.timing_humanization_behavior: microtiming is relational to swing pulse and ensemble role; no random jitter
Swing.continuous_performance_control: expression, articulation, breath and comping-density controls
Swing.sound_effects_intent: room/reverb restrained; target tone may be warm/natural
Swing.mix_prominence_intent: bass/ride time feel clear; melody and comping leave mutual space
Swing.production_mastering_intent: preserve transient nuance and dynamic headroom
Swing.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: sax/piano target voices may be electronic patches but must retain canonical role behavior

Jazz Ballad.groove_behavior: slow swing, rubato or straight ballad feel; pulse can soften at phrase edges
Jazz Ballad.phrase_behavior: long lyrical phrases with pickups, breath, delayed resolutions and spacious turnarounds
Jazz Ballad.harmony_behavior: extended jazz harmony with slow harmonic rhythm, altered dominants and substitutions as controlled options
Jazz Ballad.bass_behavior: sparse roots/tenths/walking fragments; bass avoids overcrowding
Jazz Ballad.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: brushes or very light kit; cymbal swells and fills used selectively
Jazz Ballad.instrument_role_behavior: piano/electric piano, bass, brushes, sax/trumpet/clarinet/flute or guitar lead
Jazz Ballad.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble follows melody breath and rubato; accompaniment thins under exposed lines
Jazz Ballad.arrangement_transformation: AABA/ABA/through-composed ballad structures with gradual dynamic arc
Jazz Ballad.dynamic_behavior: wide soft-to-medium range with intimate swells
Jazz Ballad.timing_humanization_behavior: shared rubato and laid-back placement tied to phrase
Jazz Ballad.continuous_performance_control: expression and tempo curves are essential
Jazz Ballad.sound_effects_intent: warm room/reverb; delay only when stylistically chosen
Jazz Ballad.mix_prominence_intent: lead intimate and forward; accompaniment soft and uncluttered
Jazz Ballad.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: prioritize expressive horn/keys voices and continuous control

Big Band.groove_behavior: swing or straight big-band groove with sectional figures and rhythm-section continuity
Big Band.phrase_behavior: 8/16-bar phrases, ensemble punches, call-response sections, build toward shout/feature passages
Big Band.harmony_behavior: jazz tonal/extended harmony with arranged voicings and sectional voice leading
Big Band.bass_behavior: walking or riff-based bass tied to drums and ensemble figures
Big Band.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: ride/backbeat support, setup fills and ensemble hits; accents align with horn figures
Big Band.instrument_role_behavior: sax section, trumpets, trombones, piano/guitar, bass, drum kit; optional clarinet/flute doubles
Big Band.ensemble_player_behavior: sections phrase as units; brass/reeds balance and articulate together
Big Band.arrangement_transformation: introductions, ensemble choruses, solos, backgrounds and climactic ensemble returns
Big Band.dynamic_behavior: large sectional contrasts with controlled crescendos into ensemble hits
Big Band.articulation_behavior: tight staccato/accented figures contrasted with legato section pads
Big Band.timing_humanization_behavior: section-coherent placement; brass/reed attacks align with intentional pushes/lays
Big Band.continuous_performance_control: section expression and articulation controls plus solo-feature dynamics
Big Band.sound_effects_intent: natural room with limited enhancement; avoid smearing ensemble attacks
Big Band.mix_prominence_intent: rhythm section foundation; featured section/solo foreground; backgrounds subordinate
Big Band.production_mastering_intent: retain punch and brass detail without harshness
Big Band.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires reliable section/ensemble patch mapping and articulation control

Jazz Waltz.groove_behavior: three-beat jazz pulse with swing/straight subdivision options and elastic accent patterns
Jazz Waltz.phrase_behavior: 4/8-bar jazz phrasing across 3/4; phrases may cross bar accents
Jazz Waltz.harmony_behavior: extended jazz harmony and modal options; functional cadence not mandatory
Jazz Waltz.bass_behavior: walking-in-3, roots/fifths or melodic bass according to section
Jazz Waltz.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: ride/brush pattern adapted to 3/4; avoid generic oom-pah-pah unless specifically chosen
Jazz Waltz.instrument_role_behavior: piano/guitar, bass, drum kit, horn/woodwind lead
Jazz Waltz.ensemble_player_behavior: shared 3/4 pocket with flexible comping and interactive fills
Jazz Waltz.dynamic_behavior: phrase arcs with dynamic lift into phrase 3 or 4
Jazz Waltz.articulation_behavior: legato horn phrasing, responsive comping, brush/stick variation
Jazz Waltz.timing_humanization_behavior: subtle swing placement and phrase rubato
Jazz Waltz.mix_prominence_intent: bass and cymbal pulse clear without dominating melody
Jazz Waltz.production_mastering_intent: dynamic master with controlled cymbal brightness

Bebop.phrase_behavior: dense 4/8-bar lines with pickups, enclosures, turnarounds and rapid phrase release
Bebop.harmony_behavior: fast-moving extended harmony, ii-V chains, secondary dominants, substitutions and chromatic approaches
Bebop.bass_behavior: continuous walking bass with chord-tone targets and passing approaches
Bebop.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: ride + hi-hat support; drums comp interactively rather than fixed backbeat
Bebop.instrument_role_behavior: small combo: sax/trumpet/clarinet, piano/guitar, bass, drums
Bebop.ensemble_player_behavior: high interaction; accompaniment leaves harmonic information without crowding solo line
Bebop.arrangement_transformation: head-solos-head baseline with compact ensemble statements
Bebop.dynamic_behavior: accent-driven line shaping rather than large sustained swells
Bebop.articulation_behavior: clean fast tonguing/legato alternation, ghosted notes and rhythmic accents as target permits
Bebop.timing_humanization_behavior: swing microtiming tightens at faster tempos; ensemble relational timing only
Bebop.continuous_performance_control: articulation and accent control prioritized over heavy effects
Bebop.mix_prominence_intent: melody and bass clarity prioritized over dense pads
Bebop.production_mastering_intent: fast transients, controlled cymbals and headroom
Bebop.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires fast articulation-capable lead and rhythm voices

Cool Jazz.groove_behavior: restrained swing or straight feel with more space and lighter attack than hard-driving swing
Cool Jazz.phrase_behavior: longer understated phrases, counterlines and deliberate rests
Cool Jazz.harmony_behavior: extended/modal harmony with transparent voicings and slower harmonic rhythm as options
Cool Jazz.bass_behavior: walking or sparse melodic bass; less aggressive attack
Cool Jazz.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: brushes/light kit favored; percussion leaves air
Cool Jazz.instrument_role_behavior: horn/woodwind lead, piano/guitar, bass, light drums; chamber colors allowed
Cool Jazz.ensemble_player_behavior: balanced, conversational ensemble; no section overwhelms texture
Cool Jazz.arrangement_transformation: ABA/through-composed or head/solo forms with textural restraint
Cool Jazz.articulation_behavior: soft attacks, legato lines, understated accents
Cool Jazz.sound_effects_intent: natural ambience; subtle plate/room if target uses effects
Cool Jazz.mix_prominence_intent: transparent mix with bass and melody both clear
Cool Jazz.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: favor nuanced dynamic voices over bright generic substitutions

Dixieland.groove_behavior: two-beat or four-beat early-jazz pulse with collective rhythmic lift

Dixieland.bass_behavior: two-beat roots/fifths or four-beat walking depending section
Dixieland.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: snare/bass drum/ride or period-appropriate kit behavior; energetic but not modern rock backbeat
Dixieland.instrument_role_behavior: trumpet/cornet lead role, clarinet counterline, trombone support, piano/guitar/banjo-role target, bass/tuba, drums
Dixieland.ensemble_player_behavior: simultaneous front-line roles remain differentiated: lead, obbligato, tailgate/counter-support
Dixieland.arrangement_transformation: multiple strains, breaks and ensemble returns
Dixieland.articulation_behavior: brisk tonguing, gliss/falls where supported, crisp rhythm accompaniment
Dixieland.timing_humanization_behavior: ensemble push tied to two-beat/four-beat pulse
Dixieland.sound_effects_intent: small-room/live-band character; avoid heavy modern processing
Dixieland.mix_prominence_intent: front line clear with rhythm foundation supportive

Jazz Fusion.bass_behavior: electric bass may be syncopated, melodic, slapped/picked or pedal-based according to section

Jazz Fusion.instrument_role_behavior: electric guitar, electric bass, drums, keys/synth target, sax/brass/woodwind lead options
Jazz Fusion.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm section tightly interlocks while soloists can float over groove
Jazz Fusion.arrangement_transformation: riff sections, solo development, breakdowns and climactic returns
Jazz Fusion.dynamic_behavior: broad dynamic range from atmospheric openings to high-energy sections
Jazz Fusion.articulation_behavior: clean/fused articulation: legato leads, accented riffs, guitar sustain, crisp drums
Jazz Fusion.timing_humanization_behavior: humanized within tight pocket; odd-meter groupings remain stable
Jazz Fusion.continuous_performance_control: expression, modulation, pitch bend and target-specific effects may be prominent
Jazz Fusion.sound_effects_intent: delay/chorus/drive/synth effects allowed as controlled style components
Jazz Fusion.mix_prominence_intent: bass/drums strong but melodic lead remains intelligible

Rhythm and Blues.phrase_behavior: 4/8-bar vocal/instrumental phrases with turnarounds and call-response
Rhythm and Blues.harmony_behavior: blues/gospel-derived tonal harmony, dominant color and repeated progressions with variation

Rhythm and Blues.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: firm snare backbeat, kick pocket, hats/ride; shuffle variants allowed
Rhythm and Blues.instrument_role_behavior: voice or horn/guitar lead, piano/electric piano, guitar, bass, drums, optional brass
Rhythm and Blues.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm section pocket supports lead; responses occupy gaps rather than overlap constantly
Rhythm and Blues.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus, blues-based or sectional song forms
Rhythm and Blues.dynamic_behavior: medium-to-strong groove dynamics with chorus lift
Rhythm and Blues.articulation_behavior: expressive bends/scoops, guitar accents and strong drum backbeat
Rhythm and Blues.timing_humanization_behavior: pocket may sit slightly behind/around beat but remains ensemble-coherent

Soul.groove_behavior: deep backbeat pocket with gospel/blues inflection and possible triplet feel
Soul.phrase_behavior: vocal-like arcs, call-response and rising emotional intensity across sections
Soul.harmony_behavior: gospel/blues/tonal harmony with dominant, plagal and chromatic color as controlled options
Soul.bass_behavior: melodic supportive bass that locks with drums but can answer phrases
Soul.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: backbeat kit with fills and tambourine/hand-percussion target options
Soul.instrument_role_behavior: voice/lead, piano/organ/electric-piano target, guitar, bass, drums, horns/strings optional
Soul.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble breathes around lead; horn/string responses reinforce section peaks
Soul.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus/bridge or sectional builds with emotional climax
Soul.dynamic_behavior: strong dynamic storytelling; choruses and bridges may expand orchestration
Soul.articulation_behavior: expressive lead bends/scoops, sustained keys, guitar fills, horn accents
Soul.timing_humanization_behavior: laid-back pocket with shared phrase pushes
Soul.continuous_performance_control: continuous lead expression and ensemble swells
Soul.sound_effects_intent: warm reverb/saturation optional; avoid overprocessing expressive lead

Funk.phrase_behavior: short riff-based phrases, breaks, vamps and call-response cells
Funk.harmony_behavior: vamp-based harmony, dominant/minor-seventh color and static harmony common; harmonic complexity serves groove
Funk.bass_behavior: highly syncopated electric bass with ghost/rest space and strong relationship to kick
Funk.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: tight kick/snare/hats with ghost-note and syncopation possibilities; fills do not break pocket
Funk.instrument_role_behavior: electric bass, clean rhythmic guitar, drums, clav/EP/synth target, horns optional
Funk.ensemble_player_behavior: all rhythm parts interlock; no one part fills every subdivision
Funk.arrangement_transformation: vamp sections, breaks, horn hits and density changes rather than long harmonic forms
Funk.articulation_behavior: short guitar attacks, bass accents, horn stabs, tight drum articulation
Funk.timing_humanization_behavior: microtiming shared by pocket; often slightly laid-back subdivisions without random drift
Funk.continuous_performance_control: velocity/articulation and filter/modulation where target resources support them
Funk.sound_effects_intent: dry/tight core with selective wah/filter/room effects
Funk.mix_prominence_intent: bass and kick prominent; guitar/keys occupy separate rhythmic slots
Funk.production_mastering_intent: punchy, dry-to-warm master; preserve transient contrast
Funk.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires responsive bass/guitar/drum voices and optional clav/EP/horn targets

Contemporary R&B.bass_behavior: sub/electric bass sustained or syncopated, often sparse around lead
Contemporary R&B.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: hybrid electronic/acoustic percussion, half-time snare/clap, detailed hats and low-end kick

Contemporary R&B.dynamic_behavior: intimate verses with larger chorus layers; automated swells common

Contemporary R&B.timing_humanization_behavior: laid-back pocket and quantized-plus-human hybrid timing

Contemporary R&B.mix_prominence_intent: lead and low end foreground; pads/effects placed behind

Contemporary R&B.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires electronic voice/patch access in addition to canonical instruments

Neo-Soul-related.phrase_behavior: elastic phrase entrances, behind-beat lead feel and longer harmonic phrases
Neo-Soul-related.harmony_behavior: rich extended harmony, altered colors, chromatic voice leading and gospel/jazz influence

Two-Step.continuous_performance_control: limited continuous control; articulation and velocity central
Two-Step.mix_prominence_intent: dance pulse and melody both clear
Two-Step.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: preserve two-beat pulse and acoustic/electric country voice mapping

Country Waltz.groove_behavior: strong first beat with lighter beats two/three; country waltz rather than generic classical waltz
Country Waltz.harmony_behavior: simple tonal country harmony with secondary dominant/passing color optional
Country Waltz.bass_behavior: root on beat one, fifth/approach support on later beats as baseline
Country Waltz.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: light waltz kit/brushes or percussion; not mandatory
Country Waltz.instrument_role_behavior: acoustic guitar, bass, fiddle/steel/piano target colors
Country Waltz.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble emphasizes three-beat dance flow and melody support
Country Waltz.articulation_behavior: smooth strum, legato fiddle/steel, soft drum articulation
Country Waltz.timing_humanization_behavior: subtle rubato without losing dance pulse
Country Waltz.mix_prominence_intent: melody forward, bass beat-one foundation supportive

Bluegrass-related.scope_note: Bluegrass-related controlled baseline, not a claim to represent every traditional or regional practice.
Bluegrass-related.groove_behavior: driving acoustic subdivision with strong offbeat/chop relationships and forward momentum
Bluegrass-related.phrase_behavior: short 4/8-bar phrases, breaks, turnarounds and solo exchanges
Bluegrass-related.harmony_behavior: direct tonal harmony with I/IV/V focus and modal/blues color as appropriate
Bluegrass-related.bass_behavior: upright-style two-beat or walking support; avoids sustained sub-bass aesthetic
Bluegrass-related.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: often no drum kit in traditional texture; if drums used in related/hybrid profile they remain restrained
Bluegrass-related.instrument_role_behavior: acoustic guitar, double bass, fiddle/mandolin/banjo target voices; optional dobro target
Bluegrass-related.ensemble_player_behavior: acoustic instruments interlock; solo breaks rotate while rhythm maintains drive
Bluegrass-related.arrangement_transformation: strophic song/tune, break exchanges and instrumental returns
Bluegrass-related.dynamic_behavior: acoustic dynamic accents with solo-feature lift
Bluegrass-related.articulation_behavior: fast picking/bowing/chop articulation and crisp note release
Bluegrass-related.timing_humanization_behavior: tight shared pulse with natural acoustic push
Bluegrass-related.continuous_performance_control: velocity/articulation and limited expression; preserve fast note clarity
Bluegrass-related.sound_effects_intent: natural room only; avoid heavy synthetic processing
Bluegrass-related.mix_prominence_intent: acoustic midrange clarity with bass audible but not sub-heavy
Bluegrass-related.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires convincing acoustic string target patches; do not substitute rock guitars silently

Bossa Nova.scope_note: Controlled bossa nova baseline; avoids treating all Brazilian music as one groove.
Bossa Nova.groove_behavior: understated syncopated Brazilian bossa pulse; guitar/piano rhythm and percussion interlock without heavy backbeat
Bossa Nova.phrase_behavior: smooth 4/8-bar melodic phrases with syncopated entries and relaxed cadences
Bossa Nova.harmony_behavior: jazz-influenced extended tonal harmony with chromatic voice leading and secondary dominants common as options
Bossa Nova.bass_behavior: syncopated root/chord-tone motion, often sparse and supportive
Bossa Nova.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: light percussion/shaker/brush/conga-role target; never generic rock backbeat by default
Bossa Nova.instrument_role_behavior: nylon/acoustic guitar role, piano/EP, bass, light percussion, flute/voice-like lead
Bossa Nova.ensemble_player_behavior: parts remain restrained and interlocking, with melody floating over pulse
Bossa Nova.articulation_behavior: soft guitar attack, legato lead, light percussion articulation
Bossa Nova.timing_humanization_behavior: relaxed behind-the-beat feel must remain ensemble-coherent
Bossa Nova.mix_prominence_intent: melody/guitar clear; percussion soft; bass warm
Bossa Nova.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: target needs convincing nylon/acoustic guitar, piano/EP and light percussion

Samba.scope_note: Broad samba-derived controlled baseline; regional/style subprofiles may differ.
Samba.groove_behavior: layered syncopated Brazilian samba-derived percussion with continuous forward motion
Samba.phrase_behavior: repeating phrase cells with call-response and sectional lift; melodic phrases ride across percussion grid
Samba.harmony_behavior: tonal harmony may be simple or extended; rhythmic drive is independent of harmonic complexity
Samba.bass_behavior: syncopated bass with strong relationship to low percussion and chord changes
Samba.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: layered percussion roles; each layer occupies distinct rhythmic function, with no single generic pattern claiming universality
Samba.instrument_role_behavior: percussion ensemble, bass, guitar/piano, brass/woodwind/voice-like leads as selected
Samba.ensemble_player_behavior: percussion layers interlock; ensemble accents and breaks coordinated
Samba.arrangement_transformation: sectional song/dance form with breaks and returns
Samba.dynamic_behavior: energetic but with clear section-level dynamics
Samba.articulation_behavior: crisp percussion differentiation and accented ensemble figures
Samba.timing_humanization_behavior: human microtiming is collective and layer-specific
Samba.continuous_performance_control: percussion dynamics and expression on melodic parts
Samba.mix_prominence_intent: percussion/bass foundation clear without masking melody
Samba.production_mastering_intent: punchy, lively master with controlled high percussion
Samba.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: target adapter must keep percussion identities separate rather than collapsing to generic kit

Salsa.scope_note: Controlled salsa baseline; not a universal template for all salsa traditions.
Salsa.groove_behavior: clave-organized dance groove with tumbao/montuno relationships; 2-3 or 3-2 orientation must be explicit per composition
Salsa.phrase_behavior: 8-bar phrase cycles with breaks, call-response, coro/lead-like exchanges and horn figures
Salsa.harmony_behavior: tonal harmony with cyclical progressions; jazz color and secondary dominants may appear
Salsa.bass_behavior: tumbao-like syncopated bass behavior rather than root-on-every-beat
Salsa.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: conga/timbales/bongo/shaker/cowbell target roles organized around clave; generic drum kit is not the default authority
Salsa.instrument_role_behavior: piano montuno-role target, bass, hand percussion, brass/woodwind ensemble, voice-like lead
Salsa.ensemble_player_behavior: all parts align to clave orientation while retaining role-specific syncopation
Salsa.arrangement_transformation: song sections, montuno/call-response, breaks and horn mambos as controlled possibilities
Salsa.dynamic_behavior: dance energy with pronounced sectional breaks and ensemble lifts
Salsa.articulation_behavior: percussive piano/horn attacks, articulated bass and differentiated hand percussion
Salsa.timing_humanization_behavior: layer-specific timing within a stable clave framework
Salsa.continuous_performance_control: expression on lead/horns, articulation/velocity on rhythm parts
Salsa.mix_prominence_intent: bass/piano/percussion interlock clear; horns/lead foreground during figures
Salsa.production_mastering_intent: energetic full-range master without crushing percussion dynamics
Salsa.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires mapped Latin percussion and piano/horn resources; preserve clave orientation metadata

Mambo.groove_behavior: clave-organized Afro-Cuban-derived dance pulse with strong syncopation and ensemble hits
Mambo.phrase_behavior: short rhythmic motifs, horn riffs and call-response over 8-bar cycles
Mambo.bass_behavior: syncopated bass/tumbao-role pattern tied to percussion
Mambo.instrument_role_behavior: brass-heavy ensemble, piano, bass, Latin percussion; woodwind/voice-like lead optional
Mambo.ensemble_player_behavior: horn section articulates as unit; rhythm section preserves clave relationship
Mambo.arrangement_transformation: riff sections, breaks, solos and ensemble returns
Mambo.articulation_behavior: tight horn stabs, percussive piano and crisp percussion attacks
Mambo.timing_humanization_behavior: collective groove timing; ensemble hits may anticipate beat intentionally
Mambo.continuous_performance_control: horn expression/articulation and percussion velocity controls
Mambo.mix_prominence_intent: horns and percussion prominent while bass remains defined
Mambo.production_mastering_intent: punchy, lively master with controlled brass harshness
Mambo.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires brass section + Latin percussion target resources

Rumba.scope_note: Cuban-rumba-derived project baseline. Ballroom rumba is a different profile and is not represented by this entry.
Rumba.groove_behavior: percussion-led Afro-Cuban rumba-derived framework with clave relationship and layered hand-drum interaction
Rumba.phrase_behavior: call-response and repeating phrase cycles with space for lead/ensemble exchange
Rumba.harmony_behavior: harmony may be sparse; rhythmic/communal structure can carry more weight than chord movement
Rumba.bass_behavior: bass may be absent, sparse or supportive depending subprofile; do not force salsa tumbao
Rumba.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: conga/hand percussion/claves-role target is primary; drum-kit backbeat is not default
Rumba.instrument_role_behavior: hand percussion, voice-like lead/response, bass/guitar/piano only when profile calls for them
Rumba.ensemble_player_behavior: interlocking percussion and call-response relationships drive ensemble
Rumba.arrangement_transformation: cyclical/sectional rather than generic verse-chorus by default
Rumba.dynamic_behavior: dynamic energy shaped by call-response and percussion density
Rumba.articulation_behavior: distinct hand-drum strokes and vocal-like responses
Rumba.timing_humanization_behavior: collective timing and groove; no mechanical quantization of all percussion
Rumba.mix_prominence_intent: percussion detail foreground; other parts avoid masking it
Rumba.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires hand-percussion mappings; do not confuse with ballroom rumba

Cha-Cha.groove_behavior: clave-related Cuban dance groove with characteristic cha-cha rhythmic articulation and steady dance pulse
Cha-Cha.phrase_behavior: regular 4/8-bar dance phrases with call-response figures
Cha-Cha.harmony_behavior: tonal progressions with jazz/dominant color as appropriate
Cha-Cha.bass_behavior: syncopated bass supporting dance pulse rather than rock roots
Cha-Cha.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: guiro/hand percussion/conga/timbales target roles; rhythm remains light and precise
Cha-Cha.instrument_role_behavior: piano, bass, Latin percussion, brass/woodwind/voice-like lead
Cha-Cha.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble aligns dance rhythm and horn/piano figures
Cha-Cha.arrangement_transformation: dance-song sections, breaks and ensemble responses
Cha-Cha.dynamic_behavior: steady medium dynamics with accented figures
Cha-Cha.articulation_behavior: short precise percussion and piano attacks, horn stabs
Cha-Cha.timing_humanization_behavior: tight dance timing with subtle human layer offsets
Cha-Cha.mix_prominence_intent: dance groove clear; lead/horns sit above rhythm
Cha-Cha.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires Latin percussion and piano/brass target mappings

Bolero.groove_behavior: slow romantic Latin bolero pulse with gentle syncopation and supportive accompaniment
Bolero.phrase_behavior: long lyrical phrases, expressive cadences and instrumental responses
Bolero.harmony_behavior: tonal harmony with chromatic passing chords, secondary dominants and rich voicings available
Bolero.bass_behavior: sparse roots/chord tones and melodic approaches; avoids overactive low end
Bolero.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: light percussion or brushed/hand-percussion support; not mandatory
Bolero.instrument_role_behavior: guitar/piano, bass, light percussion, strings/horns/voice-like lead as color
Bolero.ensemble_player_behavior: accompaniment follows lead breath and expressive rubato
Bolero.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus/ABA or through-composed romantic song form
Bolero.dynamic_behavior: strong emotional swells within generally moderate level
Bolero.articulation_behavior: legato melody, gentle guitar/piano attacks, restrained percussion
Bolero.timing_humanization_behavior: phrase rubato and behind-beat expression within stable pulse
Bolero.mix_prominence_intent: lead intimate and prominent; accompaniment soft
Bolero.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: prioritize expressive lead/guitar/piano voices and continuous control

House.groove_behavior: four-on-floor kick, offbeat/open-hat relationships, syncopated percussion and repeating dance groove
House.phrase_behavior: 8/16-bar phrase blocks with gradual layer changes and clear transitions
House.harmony_behavior: loop-based tonal/modal harmony; chord stabs/pads may be simple while timbre evolves
House.bass_behavior: repetitive sub/synth bass groove interlocked with kick, with rhythmic variation by section
House.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: electronic kick/clap/snare/hats/percussion; fills and risers mark transitions
House.instrument_role_behavior: electronic drums, synth bass, keys/pads, vocal/lead samples or instrument roles
House.ensemble_player_behavior: parts are grid-coherent but groove/humanization may vary by substyle
House.arrangement_transformation: intro/build/main/break/return/outro architecture or equivalent dance form
House.dynamic_behavior: long-form automation and section lifts rather than random note dynamics
House.articulation_behavior: short percussive stabs, sustained pads, programmed drum articulations
House.timing_humanization_behavior: quantized core with controlled swing/microtiming where profile calls for it
House.continuous_performance_control: filter, envelope, modulation, sidechain and level automation central
House.sound_effects_intent: delay/reverb/filter/drive/sidechain are production tools, not decorations
House.mix_prominence_intent: kick/sub relationship protected; lead/pads occupy separate frequency/space
House.production_mastering_intent: club-capable low end with controlled transients and headroom
House.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires synth/electronic drum target voices; preserve automation metadata

Techno.groove_behavior: persistent four-on-floor drive with evolving percussion/timbre and repetitive hypnotic cells
Techno.phrase_behavior: long 8/16/32-bar evolution; phrase identity often comes from texture/automation rather than melody
Techno.harmony_behavior: minimal, modal or nonfunctional harmonic content; timbral movement may replace chord movement
Techno.bass_behavior: sub/low synth pulse may be sustained, offbeat or rhythmic; must coexist with kick
Techno.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: electronic kick, hats, claps/noise/percussion with evolving pattern density
Techno.instrument_role_behavior: electronic drums, synth bass, synth/noise/textural voices; melodic instrument optional
Techno.ensemble_player_behavior: layer entrances/exits and automation create development
Techno.dynamic_behavior: automation-driven energy curve with controlled drops
Techno.articulation_behavior: precise programmed attacks with occasional texture tails
Techno.timing_humanization_behavior: mostly grid-stable with deliberate groove offsets only
Techno.mix_prominence_intent: kick/low-end dominant but not clipped; textures layered around it
Techno.production_mastering_intent: club-oriented, controlled loudness and transient shape
Techno.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires synth/electronic drum resources and automation-capable target

Trance.groove_behavior: steady four-on-floor drive with rolling bass, arpeggiation and long tension/release cycles
Trance.phrase_behavior: 16/32-bar phrases with intro, build, breakdown, rise and return/drop-like peak
Trance.harmony_behavior: tonal/modal progressions with sustained pads, arpeggios and strong melodic hooks
Trance.bass_behavior: rolling or offbeat synth bass tightly sidechained/interlocked with kick
Trance.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: electronic kick, hats, claps and risers; density expands toward peaks
Trance.instrument_role_behavior: synth bass, pads, arps, lead synth/voice-like melody, electronic drums
Trance.ensemble_player_behavior: layered electronic ensemble develops by automation and register
Trance.dynamic_behavior: large section-scale crescendos and breakdown contrast
Trance.articulation_behavior: sustained pads, gated/arpeggiated textures, bright lead articulation
Trance.timing_humanization_behavior: grid-stable core with controlled groove; phrase timing driven by long sections
Trance.continuous_performance_control: filter cutoff, resonance, envelopes, modulation, sidechain and expression essential
Trance.mix_prominence_intent: kick/bass protected; lead and pads wide but controlled
Trance.production_mastering_intent: wide, bright, energetic master with harshness control
Trance.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires synth/FX resources and automation-capable target

Ambient Electronic.scope_note: Electronic ambient baseline; not automatically New Age or meditation music.
Ambient Electronic.groove_behavior: pulse may be absent, soft or slowly repeating; texture evolution is primary
Ambient Electronic.phrase_behavior: very long arcs with gradual timbral/registral motion and extended silence/space
Ambient Electronic.harmony_behavior: modal, drone, cluster or slowly changing tonal harmony; functional cadence optional
Ambient Electronic.bass_behavior: bass may be drone/sub field, sparse tonal support or absent
Ambient Electronic.instrument_role_behavior: pads, synth textures, processed acoustic sources, drones, sparse melodic instruments
Ambient Electronic.ensemble_player_behavior: layers behave as evolving fields with foreground events emerging selectively
Ambient Electronic.articulation_behavior: soft attacks, sustained tones, granular/textural articulations
Ambient Electronic.timing_humanization_behavior: timing can float; when pulse exists, humanization is slow and coherent
Ambient Electronic.mix_prominence_intent: depth and width prioritized; no constant foreground requirement
Ambient Electronic.production_mastering_intent: high dynamic headroom, low harshness, preserve tails
Ambient Electronic.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires synth/texture resources and long-tail automation

Downtempo.groove_behavior: laid-back electronic/breakbeat groove with spacious subdivision and restrained tempo
Downtempo.phrase_behavior: 8/16-bar loops with evolving textures and melodic fragments
Downtempo.harmony_behavior: tonal/modal loops, extended chords or sparse harmonic fields
Downtempo.bass_behavior: warm sub/electric bass groove with space around kick
Downtempo.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: electronic/acoustic hybrid drums, often softer transients than dancefloor styles
Downtempo.instrument_role_behavior: electronic drums, bass, pads/keys, samples/textures, guitar/lead optional
Downtempo.ensemble_player_behavior: parts emphasize pocket and atmosphere over density
Downtempo.articulation_behavior: softened drum attacks, sustained textures, selective accents
Downtempo.sound_effects_intent: reverb/delay/saturation texture common as controlled options
Downtempo.production_mastering_intent: smooth master with preserved groove dynamics
Downtempo.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires electronic resources plus optional acoustic target voices

Breakbeat-related.groove_behavior: syncopated broken drum patterns rather than mandatory four-on-floor; chopped/accented subdivisions define groove
Breakbeat-related.phrase_behavior: 4/8/16-bar loops with fills, edits and pattern mutations
Breakbeat-related.harmony_behavior: harmony may be tonal, modal or minimal; rhythm is primary identifier
Breakbeat-related.bass_behavior: sub/synth/electric bass syncopates around broken kick pattern
Breakbeat-related.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: chopped/sampled-style or originally programmed breaks with ghost notes and fills
Breakbeat-related.instrument_role_behavior: electronic drums, bass, synth/keys/samples, lead instruments as selected
Breakbeat-related.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm layers interact through syncopation; fills preserve phrase direction
Breakbeat-related.articulation_behavior: sharp drum edits, ghost notes, stutters where controlled
Breakbeat-related.timing_humanization_behavior: groove/swing offsets may be important; preserve pattern feel
Breakbeat-related.mix_prominence_intent: drums/bass prominent; melodic material arranged around break
Breakbeat-related.production_mastering_intent: punchy transient master with sub control
Breakbeat-related.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires electronic drum editing and automation capability

Garage-related.scope_note: Garage-related baseline; specific UKG/2-step/speed-garage subprofiles may override.
Garage-related.groove_behavior: shuffled/syncopated garage-derived groove; 2-step kick placement available instead of continuous four-on-floor
Garage-related.phrase_behavior: 8/16-bar dance phrases with vocal/lead chops and quick transitions
Garage-related.bass_behavior: sub bass syncopated with sparse kick pattern; sliding notes optional by target
Garage-related.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: shuffled hats, claps/snares and syncopated kicks; ghost percussion may fill gaps
Garage-related.instrument_role_behavior: electronic drums, sub/synth bass, chords/keys, vocal/lead sample-like roles
Garage-related.ensemble_player_behavior: layers share shuffle/swing grid while retaining syncopation
Garage-related.dynamic_behavior: energy lifts by percussion/bass density and vocal/lead entries
Garage-related.articulation_behavior: short stabs, chopped lead articulation, tight percussion
Garage-related.timing_humanization_behavior: shuffle microtiming is structural and shared
Garage-related.sound_effects_intent: reverb/delay/chop and bass processing as controlled tools
Garage-related.mix_prominence_intent: sub and snare/clap clear; chords/lead do not mask them
Garage-related.production_mastering_intent: tight dance master with controlled sub
Garage-related.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires shuffle-capable electronic drums and sub-bass/synth patches

Experimental Electronic.scope_note: Experimental category resolves through explicit component choices; randomness alone is not a profile.
Experimental Electronic.groove_behavior: no single mandatory groove; composition must declare pulse, free-time, additive grouping or algorithmic timing explicitly
Experimental Electronic.phrase_behavior: phrase/section logic may be textural, algorithmic, motivic or conventional but must be declared and traceable
Experimental Electronic.harmony_behavior: tonal, modal, atonal, spectral, drone or process-based harmony allowed when explicitly selected
Experimental Electronic.bass_behavior: bass may be absent, tonal, textural or rhythmic; role must be declared
Experimental Electronic.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: percussion may be conventional, electronic, found-sound or absent; pattern must be specified
Experimental Electronic.instrument_role_behavior: any controlled instrument/sound resource with explicit role and provenance
Experimental Electronic.ensemble_player_behavior: relationships defined per component map; no generic randomization as substitute for design
Experimental Electronic.arrangement_transformation: through-composed/component-based structure with explicit transformation rules
Experimental Electronic.timing_humanization_behavior: timing transformation must be intentional and reproducible
Experimental Electronic.sound_effects_intent: effects may be compositional processes, with parameters traceable
Experimental Electronic.mix_prominence_intent: mix hierarchy explicitly declared rather than assumed
Experimental Electronic.production_mastering_intent: mastering preserves intended extremes without clipping
Experimental Electronic.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: adapter must support declared resources; unsupported behaviors block rather than substitute

Eclectic New Indie.scope_note: 2026 SoundCloud emerging new-indie scene profile; treated as a scene, not mature universal genre grammar.
Eclectic New Indie.groove_behavior: flexible indie/rock/folk/hip-hop-informed pulse; live-feeling or programmed groove may coexist
Eclectic New Indie.phrase_behavior: song-oriented phrases with vulnerable/intimate verses and dynamic chorus or textural shifts
Eclectic New Indie.harmony_behavior: simple indie harmony, alt-rock motion, R&B color or plugg-adjacent loop language may coexist by component map
Eclectic New Indie.bass_behavior: electric/acoustic bass or programmed sub depending track; avoid assuming one palette
Eclectic New Indie.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: live drum, drum-machine or hybrid behavior explicitly selected
Eclectic New Indie.instrument_role_behavior: guitar-led or guitar-less arrangements, vocals/lead, bass, live/programmed drums, digital textures
Eclectic New Indie.ensemble_player_behavior: DIY/raw character may coexist with precise programmed elements
Eclectic New Indie.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus or short scene-driven structures; contrast between acoustic/raw and electronic layers
Eclectic New Indie.articulation_behavior: raw guitar/vocal-like articulation, lo-fi textures, programmed transients as selected
Eclectic New Indie.timing_humanization_behavior: human/live timing or programmed grid chosen by component, not averaged blindly
Eclectic New Indie.sound_effects_intent: chorus, distortion, saturation, digital artifacts and room tone may be deliberate
Eclectic New Indie.mix_prominence_intent: lead intimacy prioritized; production artifacts are supporting identity

Mexican Reggaeton.scope_note: 2026 Mexico City emerging scene baseline, not a definition of all Mexican reggaeton.
Mexican Reggaeton.groove_behavior: reggaeton/dembow-derived pulse may combine with trap, plugg, jerk and alternative hip-hop components; component mix is explicit
Mexican Reggaeton.phrase_behavior: short hook-oriented phrases with rap/vocal-like cadence and beat-switch possibilities
Mexican Reggaeton.harmony_behavior: loop-based minor/modal/tonal harmony; harmonic simplicity may leave room for rhythm/texture
Mexican Reggaeton.bass_behavior: sub/808-like or synth bass tied to kick/dembow pattern; slides optional by target
Mexican Reggaeton.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: dembow-derived and trap/plugg/jerk-influenced electronic percussion may coexist by component map
Mexican Reggaeton.instrument_role_behavior: electronic drums, sub/synth bass, synth/sample textures, voice/lead and optional guitar/alternative elements
Mexican Reggaeton.ensemble_player_behavior: production components may change quickly between sections while preserving scene identity
Mexican Reggaeton.dynamic_behavior: strong drops and hook lifts; dynamic contrast often production-driven
Mexican Reggaeton.articulation_behavior: programmed transients, vocal-like lead articulation and sample chops
Mexican Reggaeton.timing_humanization_behavior: grid-based with genre-component swing/jerk offsets when intentionally selected
Mexican Reggaeton.sound_effects_intent: distortion, reverb, delay, clipping-style texture only as controlled production choices

Chugg / #chugg.scope_note: Provisional controlled baseline: SoundCloud identifies #chugg as a scene-specific evolution of plugg within the fast-growing Mexican reggaeton ecosystem. Detailed grammar remains intentionally flexible.
Chugg / #chugg.groove_behavior: plugg-derived emerging groove within the Mexican reggaeton scene; sparse syncopation, trap/plugg textures and local scene variation expected

Chugg / #chugg.ensemble_player_behavior: minimal layers can create space; production edits may function as arrangement events
Chugg / #chugg.dynamic_behavior: drop/entry contrasts rather than orchestral dynamic curves
Chugg / #chugg.articulation_behavior: short programmed attacks, stutters/chops and sustained synth tails as selected

Afrobeats.scope_note: Broad contemporary Afrobeats umbrella; explicitly distinct from Afrobeat.
Afrobeats.groove_behavior: groove-first beat with layered syncopation and percussion/bass interlock; no single universal pattern
Afrobeats.phrase_behavior: hook-forward phrases, call-response and evolving production layers
Afrobeats.harmony_behavior: tonal/modal loop-based harmony drawing flexibly from pop, R&B, highlife, hip-hop and regional influences
Afrobeats.bass_behavior: syncopated melodic bass tied to percussion rather than root-only behavior
Afrobeats.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: layered percussion with humanized timing and distinct roles; electronic/acoustic hybrid common
Afrobeats.instrument_role_behavior: percussion, bass, guitar/keys/synth, voice/lead and regional instrument colors when explicitly profiled
Afrobeats.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm parts interlock and leave space; call-response roles are common options
Afrobeats.arrangement_transformation: verse/hook/bridge or loop-evolving form with strong sectional production contrast
Afrobeats.dynamic_behavior: section-based energy changes rather than constant maximum level
Afrobeats.articulation_behavior: percussive guitar/keys, articulated bass and layered percussion
Afrobeats.timing_humanization_behavior: humanized groove timing controlled per layer
Afrobeats.mix_prominence_intent: groove foundation clear with lead/hook foreground
Afrobeats.production_mastering_intent: punchy warm master; low end controlled
Afrobeats.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires percussion variety and hybrid electronic/acoustic target resources

Afro-Latin / Afrobeats Fusion.scope_note: Fusion resolver, not one fixed genre grammar.

Afro-Latin / Afrobeats Fusion.phrase_behavior: hook/call-response phrases with sectional emphasis on one source component or another

Afro-Latin / Afrobeats Fusion.ensemble_player_behavior: layers preserve provenance and avoid stacking every rhythm simultaneously
